blocks.html: In addition to the requirements set forth elsewhere in this code, Group H-5 shall comply with the provisions of the New York City Fire Code and Section 415.9 of this code, including, but not limited to, automatic sprinkler protection for workstations, gas cabinets, exhausted enclosures, pass-throughs in exit access corridors and exhaust ducts.
